### New in 1.5.3
- **Finished Books Excluded from Continue Reading**: Marking a book as finished now automatically clears it from the "Continue reading" card on the Home page.
- **Single Bookmark per Book**: Each book now maintains strictly one bookmark at a time. Placing a bookmark on any page repositions the bookmark to that page. Finishing a book also clears pure bookmarks.
- **Google Account Chooser**: Tapping "Continue with Google" on first launch displays all available Google accounts for seamless one-tap selection, with an option to type any email manually.
- **Guided Section Walkthrough**: Following Google sign-in, an interactive walkthrough with animated bouncing arrow indicators guides you through each section of Shelfwise, complete with a prominent "Skip" button.
- **Share Sanctuary Button**: Added a new Share icon near the notification bell on the Home page to quickly share your bookshelves with friends.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over older versions and keeps everything.
